items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: This man here, his name was Archie Martin... I guess Brassley... This is way back. Back, I think in 1930, this picture was made. You notice we were wearing sashes... We were out there young.

ctx.x: And this man here named Howard Lanier, he's a tenor player. He's from Leland, Mississippi. This man here is Jesse Gardner. Jesse Gardner, the great alto man of the day I think he is. He's from Charleston, South Carolina. She's from Alexander, Louisiana. Lizette Kennedy. Well this man, Jeff Kelly, is from Monroe, Louisiana but he's there. He was the leader. He was the leader. What did he play? The alto saxophone. He's originally out of Ben Burton band. Ben Burton and Monroe, Louisiana. Yeah, I remember that. He…
especially the arrangements that I got from band leaders. Yeah.
